description: Source code for a CodeMirror mode implementation for Turtle syntax highlighting.

methods.name: tokenBase
methods.description: Tokenizes the base elements of Turtle syntax, such as URIs, literals, comments, and keywords.

methods.name: tokenLiteral
methods.description: Handles tokenization of string literals with escape sequences.

methods.name: pushContext
methods.description: Pushes a new context onto the context stack for nested structures.

methods.name: popContext
methods.description: Pops the current context from the context stack.
